How to test for accidental double clicks

Click the test area once with your left mouse button, wait about a second, and repeat. If one intentional click adds two presses and a rapid pair, repeat the test to see whether it happens consistently.

What a rapid pair tells you

The tool flags consecutive presses less than 80 milliseconds apart. Fast intentional clicks can trigger the same flag, and extra presses outside this window can still show up in the list. The test measures the events your browser received. Use the same mouse and repeat the test to check whether the result is consistent.

Measure your click speed

Use the CPS Test to measure clicks per second or take a 5 Second Click Test to compare practice rounds.
